headline: Antigua to St Barth by Yacht
primaryText:
A brand new 50 metre superyacht is spending her first winter in the Caribbean, and she is available for private charter.

Oguz Khan was launched in 2026 and is crossing the Atlantic for the first time. Be among the first guests on board for her first Caribbean season.

50.5 metres, 6 cabins, up to 12 guests, 1 group.

Rates for the 2026/27 season are published, from €125,100 per week on eligible dates. APA, VAT and applicable charges are explained in the written proposal.

Request availability for your dates and group size.
whyItWorks: The ad leads with novelty, a brand new superyacht on her first Caribbean season, which gives a reason to act now and the appeal of being among the first guests. Stating the size, cabins and a starting weekly price up front filters for serious, high-budget buyers and sets expectations before they click. The photo of the yacht at anchor with a paddleboarder sells the lifestyle, and the ad is only a few weeks old, so there is no long-run signal yet.
